parts.label: (b)
parts.part_stem:
In an experiment, two objects $A$ and $B$ are released from the side of a building, as shown in Fig. 1.1.

{{figure:figure_1_1}}

Fig. 1.1 (not to scale)

Object $A$ is released from rest at a height of $14\text{ m}$ above the horizontal ground.
Object $B$ is released with an initial upwards vertical velocity $u$ at a height of $3.6\text{ m}$ above the ground.
Both objects take the same time to reach the ground and they do not collide with each other.
Air resistance is negligible.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Calculate the time taken for object $A$ to reach the ground.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Use your answer in (b)(i) to calculate $u$.

parts.label: (c)
(c)(i)
parts.text: State and explain whether the time taken for object $B$ to reach the ground is less than, the same as or greater than the time in (b)(i).

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: By considering energy, state and explain the effect of the change in release angle on the speed at which $B$ reaches the ground.
